description.text: This program is to cultivate innovative, practical and all-round professionals who are familiar with Chinese and international commercial culture and rules, understand the primary principles of operation in both Chinese and international business, and acquire the knowledge of business management, market investigation, commercial information utilization and human resources management in the field of international business.Students of this program must have a mastery of theories and practical skills on the international trade, equip themselves with necessary knowledge for the international trade activities including basic theories, professional know-how, work ethics and professional skills, and be capable of analysis and development of the international markets, negotiation and promotion of import and export, implementation of import and export contracts, international business negotiation and correspondence, and international economic cooperation.Major Disciplines: Economics, International TradeCore Courses:Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Management, International Trade Practice, Multinational Corporation and Foreign Investment, Electronic Commerce, International FinanceFeatured CoursesSurveys on the Chinese Specialized Markets, Business Practice

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at LiaoNing Petrochemical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized.3. Academic transcript of high school4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.5. Sponsorship Certificate

requirements.text: 1.Must be a high school graduate2.In good health3.Have a good command of English
